description:
You are a researcher who wants to set up a dynamic saved search in Zotero to automatically track recent publications. Your library has 18 papers spanning from 1905 to 2020.

Your task: Create a saved search named exactly 'Papers Since 2010' that finds papers published in the year 2010 or later. This search should automatically show papers published from 2010 onwards (such as AlexNet 2012, ResNet 2016, Transformer 2017, BERT 2019, GPT-3 2020).

Steps:
1. In Zotero, go to the Edit menu (or right-click on 'My Library')
2. Select 'New Saved Search...'
3. In the dialog that appears:
   a. Set the search name to exactly: 'Papers Since 2010'
   b. Set the condition to search by 'Date' or 'Year'
   c. Set the operator to 'is after' or 'is greater than'
   d. Set the value to '2009' (to include 2010 and later) OR set it to '2010' with 'is in the year' or 'is after' operator
4. Click 'Save'

The saved search should appear in the left sidebar under your collections and show approximately 8 papers (all the ML papers from 2012-2020).

Note: The search name must be exactly 'Papers Since 2010'.
